text:
monica-marketing: Quick sync — building the benchmark launch playbook. Need final hero claim + three visual concepts + short webinar hook + inbound form fields/routing rules. Core message: predictable dollars-per-token across latency tiers. Advice?

ethan-growth: For paid channels use a punchy claim. Suggest two headline tests: 1) "Lower inference spend, keep same latency" 2) "Predictable LLM SLAs at cloud speed". Also +1 for a tiny inline microcalc showing "Tokens -> $" under the hero.

mira-analytics: I'll generate three datasets: chat (median tokens 128), sync API (tokens 1024), and bulk embeddings (avg 4096). Visual proposals: A) iso-contour scatter (x=tokens, y=req/sec, color=$/k tokens, contours=p95 latency) B) side-by-side panels (latency curve | cost curve) C) waterfall breakdown per 1M tokens (model compute, memory, infra, misc).

sam-product: Prefer A + C. Also add a small note about fallback routing (if GPU pool busy, route to cheaper quantized variant with ~5-10ms added latency). We'll include that as a tooltip on the charts.

zoe-design: I can produce three hero mocks by EOD. Palette: navy for latency, lime for cost accents. For the microcalc, do we want a formula? Example to show: "1M tokens ≈ $20 (baseline)"  I'll render a tiny callout.

leo-sales: Inbound capture: fields we need on landing form -> approx monthly tokens, avg seq length, SLO (p95 target ms), number of seats, industry compliance (yes/no). Routing rules: send to SDR for score >=0.4, AE for >=0.75, otherwise self-serve nurture. Also create a checkbox for "I want a capacity review" to flag high-intent leads.

ops-bot: Heads up: webinar calendar available 2026-06-02 11:00 PT. Draft reg link https://redwood.ai/serve-bench-webinar.

mira-analytics: Routing scoring function (draft):
```
score = normalize(monthly_tokens, 0, 1)*0.5 + normalize(avg_seq_len, 0, 1)*0.15 + company_stage_score*0.2 + compliance_flag*0.15
```
Where company_stage_score = 1 for enterprise, 0.5 for startup, 0 for indie; compliance_flag = 1 if yes else 0. Map: score <0.4 -> self-serve; 0.4-0.74 -> SDR demo; >=0.75 -> AE. I'll put the normalization details in the assets doc.

ethan-growth: For creative testing: Variant 1 (hero + iso-scatter), Variant 2 (two-panel), Variant 3 (waterfall + microcalc). Use Variant 1 for social paid; Variant 3 for mid-funnel email.

sam-product: Add a short tech footnote for the landing page: mention caching (prefix/KV) and quantization tips -> helps PMs understand where cost savings come from. Put a "tech notes" accordion.

zoe-design: I'll also create a 3-line hero deck (for webinar slide 1) that reads: 1) problem (unpredictable inference costs), 2) approach (routing + caching + quantization), 3) outcome (predictable $/k tokens + latency SLOs).

leo-sales: Post-webinar cadence: 1) immediate email + resource pack, 2) 48h follow-up asking for capacity numbers, 3) personalized capacity estimate for flagged leads. I'll draft templates.

mira-analytics: I'll drop two sample CSVs into #assets: chat_slice.csv and batch_slice.csv with columns: tokens_per_req, reqs_per_sec, cost_per_k, p50_ms, p95_ms. Also a small README explaining sample rate and hardware baseline. ETA 24 hours.

monica-marketing: Perfect. Final asks: Zoe, post hero mocks here once ready. Mira, upload CSVs. Ethan, set paid channel targets for the A/B run. Sam, tidy the tech footnotes. I'll compile the one-pager and a short webinar landing draft and share for sign-off tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
